# DSH annotations
English | 中文
Select assistant text in DSH Web, add a comment, and send it with your next message. Compact labels
show the original quote and comment on hover and navigate back to the source on click.
## Compatibility
Verified against the official **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web UI**. This community plugin requires no host patc
hes or custom APIs and is not affiliated with DeepSeek. Other releases and desktop distributions are
m APIs and is not affiliated with DeepSeek. Other releases and desktop distributions are unverified.
This distribution uses native reference chips: saving a comment automatically attaches a compact lab
el to the composer whose click expands or collapses the note list above it. Each row places a left-a
ligned gray comment beside its quote with a gap; long quotes use at most a quarter of the text area.
Long text is truncated. Click the quote to read the source or edit the comment to read its full tex
t. Pending rows have no hover cards; sent labels retain their previews. Comments are never written i
nto editable text. A label-only draft can be submitted with Enter or Send, and ordinary text can acc
ompany it. The history navigator receives a readable annotation title.
## Use

1. Select a passage in a completed assistant reply and choose **Add to conversation**.
2. Write a co

mment. Enter saves, Escape cancels, and Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
3. Click the composer referen
ce chip to expand or collapse the pending-note list. Click a row’s quote to navigate; its buttons ed

it or delete the comment. The blue number also reopens the editor above the original text.
4. Contin
ue typing in the main composer or submit the labels alone. Sent labels expose hover previews and sou
e main composer or submit the labels alone. Sent labels expose hover previews and source navigation.
Opening or reopening **Edit annotation** focuses the comment field without scrolling the conversatio
n. The editor fills its compact rounded panel and grows with the text up to the viewport limits; its
footer contains Delete, Cancel, and Save. Delete discards a new unsaved comment or removes the note
being edited. Source navigation remains in the pending list and historical labels; navigation from
the bottom aligns the selected text, including inside long paragraphs. Successful admission clears t
his round’s blue markers and restarts the next round at 1; historical labels retain their source coo
’s blue markers and restarts the next round at 1; historical labels retain their source coordinates.
Unsent notes stay in this browser and do not synchronize between devices. Native submission failure
restores reference chips. If closing the page or cancellation leaves admission uncertain, inspect th
e conversation before explicitly attaching the notes again. Disable other annotation plugins while u
before explicitly attaching the notes again. Disable other annotation plugins while using this one.
## Install
Release archives contain prebuilt artifacts and run no install scripts. Download the `.tgz` asset fr
om this repository’s Releases and install through `dsh plugin --profile web add <archive-path> --ign
ore-scripts`. Follow DSH’s restart instructions and refresh the page.
## Model input
Annotations travel in one ordinary user message: optional composer text, a readable title, and a ver
sioned `dsh-annotations` JSON text block. Each note contains its number, exact quote, source coordin
ates, and comment. No system or tool message is added. Quoted text consumes input tokens.
## Known limitations
- Compatibility is currently declared only for 0.2.1-rc.2. Source navigation uses that release’s exi

sting Chat node markers; ambiguous sources retain their comments and report a navigation failure.
-
Reasoning, tool cards, cross-message selections, and mobile selection gestures are unsupported. Brow
sers without CSS Custom Highlights retain comments without a text fill.
## Development and validation
Sources live in `src/`; `scripts/build.mjs` builds the Host entry and browser module factory. After
installing development dependencies, run `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run typecheck`, and `pnpm test`. Th
e committed `lib/` artifacts share React and services with the host.
For Web regression, separately clone and build the official 0.2.1-rc.2 checkout, set `DSH_TEST_HARNE
SS` to that directory, and run `pnpm run test:web`. Tests use temporary profiles, assigned ports, an
d recorded model replies; they access no real user data or paid model. The test adapter is created t
emporarily inside that isolated checkout and removed afterward.
